purpose: Validate official Bybit linear orderbook.200 daily archives without accepting cross-day contamination, transport corruption, or undocumented sequence anomalies.

archive_boundary_rule.name: first_snapshot_matching_engine_pre_start_cts_v1
allowed_only_when: the record is the first non-empty archive record
every later record has ts >= target_day_start_ms and cts >= target_day_start_ms
ts and cts remain non-decreasing across the full archive
no other timestamp or boundary error exists
rejected_when: any non-first record has ts or cts before the target day
the first record has ts before the target day
the first record is not a snapshot
the first cts is earlier than the 2000 ms deterministic grace
any record exceeds the 2000 ms end grace
any timestamp moves backward after the first record
archive_boundary_rule.rationale: Bybit defines ts as the system-generated timestamp and cts as the matching-engine production timestamp. A first snapshot can straddle the UTC file partition by a small clock/processing interval; the exception is constrained to one first snapshot and does not permit later cross-day records.

snapshot_reset_rule.name: bybit_documented_u1_service_restart_v2
allowed_only_when: exactly one mid-stream record is type == snapshot and u == 1
the reset snapshot seq is strictly greater than the immediately previous seq
the immediately following record has u == 2
all seq values are strictly increasing except the existing terminal snapshot duplicate convention
all other u values are strictly increasing except the existing terminal snapshot duplicate convention
rejected_when: more than one u=1 mid-stream snapshot occurs
the reset is not a snapshot
the reset seq is not strictly greater than the prior seq
any unrelated u or seq ordering/duplicate failure occurs
snapshot_reset_rule.rationale: Bybit documents that u=1 can indicate a service restart and that a new snapshot must replace the local order book.

integrity_requirements: ZIP opens successfully and CRC/inflate checks pass
JSONL parses for every non-empty record
topic and symbol match the requested symbol
record type is snapshot or delta
ts and cts are integer milliseconds
u and seq are integer values
u and seq are strictly ordered under the documented exceptions
source archive SHA-256 is recorded before Drive upload
Drive restore is by immutable file ID
restored byte count and SHA-256 exactly match the source
operational_instruction: Do not modify validate_bybit_l2_archive.py in place.
If validation fails, record VALIDATION_FAILED and stop the sequential worker.
Do not invent a wider timestamp window, skip records, reconstruct data, or substitute another exchange.
Do not reprocess accepted archives unless an explicit provenance audit requires it.
Do not start Phase 2, Phase 3, Phase 4, trading, alerts, or deployment during Phase 1 acquisition.
